description_en: Queries the list of context stores
kebab_example: aliyun agentloop list-context-stores --agent-space my-agent-space --context-store-name my-context-store --context-type experience --source-type trajectory --max-results 20 --next-token MTIzNDU2Nzg5MA== --region cn-hangzhou
name: ListContextStores

parameters.help_en: The name of the AgentSpace. The name must be 2 to 64 characters in length
parameters.help_zh: AgentSpace 名称，长度 2-64 字符
parameters.name: agent_space

parameters.help_en: The name of the context store used for filtering. Exact match is supported. If this parameter is not specified, no filtering is performed
parameters.help_zh: 按上下文库名称过滤，支持精确匹配；不传表示不过滤
parameters.name: context_store_name

parameters.help_en: The type of the context store used for filtering, such as experience or memory. If this parameter is not specified, no filtering is performed
parameters.help_zh: 按上下文库类型过滤，例如 experience / memory；不传表示不过滤
parameters.name: context_type

parameters.help_en: The memory data source type used for filtering, such as manual, trajectory, or dataset. If this parameter is not specified, no filtering is performed
parameters.help_zh: 按 memory 数据源类型过滤：manual / trajectory / dataset；不传表示不过滤
parameters.name: source_type

parameters.help_en: The maximum number of context stores to return in the current request. Default value: 20. Maximum value: 100
parameters.help_zh: 本次最多返回的上下文库条数，默认 20，最大 100
parameters.name: max_results

parameters.help_en: The pagination token. To retrieve the next page, pass the nextToken value from the previous response. Do not specify this parameter for the first request
parameters.help_zh: 分页 Token，传入上一次响应中的 nextToken 翻页；首次请求不传
parameters.name: next_token

maxResults.description_en: The maximum number of results per page specified in the request
maxResults.description_zh: 请求时传入的本页最大条数，回显
maxResults.title_en: 请求时传入的本页最大条数，回显
maxResults.title_zh: 请求时传入的本页最大条数，回显

nextToken.description_en: The token for the next page. An empty string indicates that the last page is reached
nextToken.description_zh: 下一页 Token，空字符串表示已经是最后一页
nextToken.title_en: 下一页 Token，空字符串表示已经是最后一页
nextToken.title_zh: 下一页 Token，空字符串表示已经是最后一页

requestId.description_en: The request ID, which can be used to locate the request during troubleshooting
requestId.description_zh: 请求 Id，用于排查问题时定位本次请求
requestId.title_en: 请求 Id，用于排查问题时定位本次请求
requestId.title_zh: 请求 Id，用于排查问题时定位本次请求
